## Upgrading to 5.7

### Changes that do not announce themselves

- Lossy WebP (`quality` below 100) now encodes the alpha channel lossily too, at the same quality. It used to keep alpha lossless whatever `quality` said, so translucent tiles hardly shrank: `dem_hillshade` tiles are now 30–40 % smaller at `quality=70`. Their transparency is no longer exact, though. Use `quality_translucent=100` to keep translucent tiles lossless.
- In Node.js, a running `TileServer` now keeps the process alive until `stop()` is called, as an `http.Server` does. A script that started a server and relied on the process exiting without `stop()`, such as a test suite, now keeps running. Call `server.unref()` to let it exit.
- Opening a container and computing its tile pyramid now report progress, as "reading the tile index" and "computing the tile pyramid". A progress listener, such as `onProgress` in Node.js, sees these besides the conversion's own progress, each with its own id.
